articles.title: 2024 European Heritage Days
articles.excerpt: The Bull and Punched-Card Data Processing Museum opens its doors for the 2024 European Heritage Days.
articles.author: PB2I
content: For the 2024 European Heritage Days, the Bull and Punched-Card Data Processing Museum opens its doors on Saturday 21 September from 2 pm to 6 pm and on Sunday 22 September from 10 am to 12 noon and from 2 pm to 6 pm, at 5 rue Jacqueline Auriol, 90000 Belfort.

articles.title: Visit by students from the IUT computer science department
articles.excerpt: The Museum welcomes 75 students from the Belfort IUT computer science department.
articles.author: PB2I
content: On 29 and 31 May 2024, the Museum welcomes 75 students from the Belfort IUT computer science department.
Three groups of engineering students will attend a presentation on the birth of computerised data processing through a punched-card data processing workshop (still in working order today).

articles.title: Visit by the ACS Paris volunteers
articles.excerpt: The Museum welcomes the volunteers of ACS PARIS (the national association of Bull retirees).
articles.author: PB2I
content: On 24 May 2024, the Museum welcomes the volunteers of ACS PARIS (the national association of Bull retirees).

articles.title: Visit by a group from the canton of Jura
articles.excerpt: A group from the canton of Jura in Switzerland visits the Museum.
articles.author: PB2I
content: On 4 May 2024, a group from the canton of Jura in Switzerland visits the Museum. The 25 participants enjoy their visit.

articles.title: ACS and PB2I Annual General Meeting
articles.excerpt: Annual General Meeting of ACS and PB2I on 13 March 2024.
articles.author: PB2I
content: The Annual General Meeting of ACS and PB2I was held on 13 March 2024.
